_note: Licence registry (satsang-extensions 28, merged 2026-10-20): per-book licences (book always wins) and per-domain defaults, each with evidence. Gates which text records are shown: tools/merge-sources.py links a text only when this file evidences a linkable licence (RIGHTS.md taxonomy); verify-flagged defaults do not count. Edit here after checking a copyright page or terms URL; never assume free. | 2026-10-21: evidence URLs added (evidenceUrl), accesstoinsight verified, new domains/books, a urls (prefix) section for place resource links, and held (checked, unclear) entries.

accesstoinsight.org.evidence: Site "Terms of use" link -> FAQ "Copyright and terms of use": texts are on the site because their copyright holders provided them for free distribution; pages may be copied and reposted free of charge, never sold or modified; site documents CC BY 4.0

anuttaratrikakula.org.evidence: Free lectures watch-only; $150 courses + translations sold

dhammatalks.org.evidence: Site ethos + per-book licences (custom gift and CC BY-NC coexist)

dharmaseed.org.evidence: Dharma Seed talk pages + DATABASES.md (satsang-extensions 37): CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, unabridged and unmodified playback only, credit teacher + title + Dharma Seed, non-commercial; no transcripts exist
dharmaseed.org.rule: Never cut: Dharma Seed talks are played or linked whole, never clipped, trimmed or made into virtual clips (owner rule).

suttacentral.net.evidence: Licensing page: texts made available to everyone free of charge; all original SuttaCentral material (incl. its own translations) dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0; legacy translations under the terms of their copyright asserters, used by permission

muktabodha-digital-library.org.evidence: About > Data Licenses > E-Text Library: use of e-text material is covered by CC BY-NC 4.0, credit Muktabodha Indological Research Institute (IFP co-produced I000## texts carry their own terms)

nathas.org.evidence: Site footer on every page: "Using of this site content is allowed with a mandatory reference to it." (shop items are paid and not covered)

ashintejaniya.org.evidence: Books page: "Click on the links below to download or request a free copy where available."

gretil.sub.uni-goettingen.de.evidence: GRETIL registers only e-texts freely available for scholarly purposes; notice: files strictly for scholarly reference, any commercial use excluded, copyright stays with the original holders (many files now CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
